description:
A CAD application built with Rust — 2D/3D drawing, DWG/DXF support, and GPU-accelerated rendering.


OpenCADStudio - Release v2026.43 (2026-10-25)
> Summary: Extended native dynamic block authoring and evaluation; introduced QuickCalc; expanded HATCH, MLINE, REGION, drafting, automation and plugin-grip workflows; substantially improved DGN, PDF, STEP, IGES, WMF and 3D Studio exchange; and fixed drawing, annotation, plotting, rendering and large-drawing performance issues.
🌟 Notable Release Notes
- Dynamic Block Authoring and Evaluation: Added native value sets, paired and XY move sets, complete parameter frames, grip roles and positioning, action base points and offsets, polygon Stretch frames, Polar Stretch endpoint bindings, multi-output Lookup tables, evaluated geometry previews, dependency status and construction geometry. Authoring graphs and constraints can be edited on references and retained through copy, insert and Save Block As. (Contributed by @KarimJerbi)
- Everyday Drafting and Geometry: Added live crossing-box EXTEND, Shift-based STRETCH subtraction, one-click HATCH trimming that preserves curved edges and holes, MLINE trimming, geometric OVERKILL settings, all-match FIND, REGION edge snaps/dimensions, PELLIPSE, selection-scoped FLATTEN, richer LIST and layer isolation prompts. (Contributed by @gianlucafiore, @HakanSeven12, @sclMAX and @YsDirector)
- Drawing Exchange and Interoperability: Expanded DGN V7/V8 support for dimensions, notes, meshes, levels, curves and cells; improved PDF text and curved fills with encrypted-file password entry; and improved STEP, IGES, WMF and 3D Studio geometry/material handling. Added valid AP214 STEP mesh export and periodic DWG spline DXF support. (Contributed by @ramox81 and @HakanSeven12)
- Annotation and Drawing Data: Improved dimension and MLeader rendering/editing, clipboard dependency remapping, field and attribute copying, and purge safety so common edits and cross-drawing transfers preserve their content and references. (Contributed by @ramox81, @cmlad26, @insanedps and @HakanSeven12)
- QuickCalc: Added a dockable Standard/Scientific calculator with a shared expression engine for CAL, point and distance functions, units, $ variables, system-variable getvar(), history, memory and keypad tools. (Contributed by @MarcelP102 and @HakanSeven12)
- Large Drawing Performance: Reduced work in snapping, constraint solving, hatch processing, STEP reads, block previews, property aggregation, scene queries and repeated solid rendering. Benchmarked gains include a 3.1× Properties rebuild for 2,000 entities, 5.3× STEP assembly lookup, 4.3× constraint drag preview, and 27× bulk constraint refresh. (Contributed by @KarimJerbi, @gianlucafiore, @HakanSeven12, @ramox81 and @MarcelP102)
- Automation and Data Workflows: Added headless --batch/--each drawing scripts, more dash-form commands, open-document automation without tab activation, OLE insertion/properties, hyperlink editing, data-link actions, richer extraction fields and semantic block/attribute data in MCP ocs_read. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12, @ramox81 and @KarimJerbi)
- Workspace and Navigation: Added display-locked viewport pan/zoom, pointer-centered orbit, revised Zoom Extents framing, responsive floating palettes and a faster block gallery with cached, visible-row previews. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12 and @MarcelP102)
- Plugin Grips and Host API: Added API v11–v13 built-in/custom grip reads and drags, live geometry, deterministic notifications, constraint and record APIs, and quiet commands. Non-blocking delivery, settle recovery and improved reentrant host access keep plugin grips responsive. (Contributed by @schoeller)
🚀 New Features
Blocks & Definitions
- Parameter Value Sets and Frames: Added min/max bounds, increments and allowed values for Linear, Polar, XY and Rotation parameters; paired Move and XY Move sets; complete native parameter frames; and parameter-specific Base, End and XY grips with relocatable display positions. (Contributed by @KarimJerbi)
- Stretch and Polar Stretch Authoring: Added Linear Stretch Pair, XY Stretch Box Set and Polar Stretch Pair authoring, polygon Stretch frames, native Stretch targets for arcs, circles, ellipses, points and text, and Base/End bindings. Polar Stretch can separately select rotation geometry and retain rotate-only target size. (Contributed by @KarimJerbi)
- Actions and Grip Controls: Added independent Rotate/Scale base points and native base offsets, Move/Stretch distance and angle overrides, action bars, BGRIPSET, grip repositioning, BCYCLEORDER, and authoring graphics/settings controls. Added BASSOCIATE to repair orphaned action bindings and feedback for dependency markers and grip roles. (Contributed by @KarimJerbi)
- Lookup, Properties and Evaluation: Lookup tables now evaluate formulas and ranges, support multiple outputs, retain shared parameter links and allow row selection on references. Added native Flip labels, parameter names/descriptions, Visibility descriptions and reference properties. Drawing and Test Block previews show evaluated parameter geometry without mutating the resident drawing. (Contributed by @KarimJerbi)
- Construction Geometry and Status: Added BCONSTRUCTION Convert/Revert and Show/Hide, persisted construction membership, and per-entity constraint status with editor shading. Added RESETBLOCK, BTABLE, and PARAMETERSCLOSE; added BLOCKEDITLOCK and read-only editor session variables. (Contributed by @KarimJerbi)
- Block Properties Tables and Save As: Added native table grips with must-match behavior and reference-side row choice. Save Block As copies structured parameters, grips, actions, Lookup tables, visibility records and retained associative constraint graphs onto independent handles. (Contributed by @KarimJerbi)
- Block Gallery: Added a gallery for drawing blocks with cached thumbnails, indexed names and previews generated for visible rows; library thumbnails load in the background. (Contributed by @MarcelP102)
Drafting, Annotation & Calculation
- Live EXTEND and STRETCH: Added spatially filtered live box/lasso previews, crossing-box extension of multiple lines to a shared boundary, and Shift-window or Shift-click subtraction of selected grips/vertices during STRETCH. Previews retain fixed original geometry for snapping and handle blocks, full precision and commit/cancel behavior. (Contributed by @gianlucafiore)
- HATCH Editing: Added HATCHEDIT picking on fills, double-click and context-menu editing, fill-only entity selection, and trimming of polygonal and circular regions by finite line/circle boundaries. Repeated cuts preserve analytic curved edges, circular holes and islands; clipped associative hatches detach safely with a notice. (Contributed by @gianlucafiore, @YsDirector and @HakanSeven12)
- Geometry Commands: Added geometry-based OVERKILL with a settings dialog and -OVERKILL, all-match FIND with zoom-to-result, MLINE trimming between cutting edges, pattern-HATCH EXPLODE, and collinear line/same-circle arc JOIN across gaps. FILLET now ends after one corner unless Multiple is selected. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
- Regions, Snapping and Dimensions: Added REGION boundary object snaps and mouse-pick acquisition, circular REGION edge measurements and associative dimensions, radius/diameter picks through blocks and viewports, and persisted snap aperture through Options and APERTURE. The Shift+right-click snap menu accepts letter keys and Perpendicular snaps rank with other nearest point snaps. (Contributed by @sclMAX and @HakanSeven12)
- Dimensions and Text: Added per-object annotative state, multi-dimension property rows, angular measurements stored/read as radians, DIMJUST text beside extension lines, and DATAEXTRACTION position and rotation columns. Dimension context fit overrides are applied per scale. (Contributed by @ramox81, @cmlad26 and @HakanSeven12)
- Drafting Input and Layers: Added PELLIPSE to create bulged-polyline ellipses, stored with the drawing; Shift temporarily suspends Ortho and typed <angle applies only to the next point. LAYISO prompts for objects and LAYUNISO restores only layers it isolated; layer states can freeze layers in one viewport. FLATTEN and LIST prompt for objects, and LIST includes polyline vertices. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
- QuickCalc and CAL: Added a shared lexer/parser/evaluator supporting point literals and functions, assignments, ans, unit suffixes, angle modes, trigonometry, scientific functions and system-variable getvar(). Added dockable Standard and Scientific keypads, memory/history, unit conversion and persistent global $ constants/functions. (Contributed by @MarcelP102; review fixes by @HakanSeven12)
- Hyperlinks, OLE and Data: Added Insert/Edit Hyperlink, -HYPERLINK, HYPERLINKOPTIONS, HYPERLINKBASE and Ctrl+K; added INSERTOBJ, OLE variables and an OLE Properties panel; added Insert-tab Data and Linking & Extraction panels with Data Link download/upload actions. DATAEXTRACTION includes insert/text rotation and Position X/Y/Z. (Contributed by @ramox81)
References, Import & Export
- DGN Import: Expanded V7/V8 support for named levels, cells, shared/unshared cell placement, 3D meshes, curves, filled shapes, dimensions and notes. Imported dimensions use file dimension styles/settings; V7 UOR fractions, sub-units, clockwise arcs, text code pages/fonts and dimension layout are handled. Empty imports now report that nothing was imported. (Contributed by @ramox81)
- PDF Import and Passwords: Added a Password Protected PDF dialog for open/permission passwords and encrypted PDF underlays. Import reads optional-content layers, text runs, fill/stroke paths, linework and curved regions; supports clipping and text-height/font mapping; and reports when a page requires a password. (Contributed by @ramox81)
